decisions.reason: Making the placard dual-sided does not change the DJ-turntable-inspired visual identity.
The placard-side decision does not change the beige primary color or green accent color.
The references to barista-facing and customer-facing sides describe placard visibility and do not alter the spout's geometry, construction, or orientation.
Placard wording and visibility do not affect bowl capacity, depth, or form.
The source changes the placard requirement but does not independently change the system-layout or CAD deliverable requirement.
Dual-sided placard wording has no effect on matcha texture, foam quality, or mixing behavior.
The placard visibility change does not alter splash-control behavior or mitigation measures.
The source does not request a BOM or component-selection change; the nearby BOM approval is a separate message.
Displaying identical placard wording on both sides does not change the electrical wiring-plan requirement.
The placard decision does not revise the prototype sourcing policy or rapid-build priority.
The placard-side change does not affect valve control, dispensing flow, or the mix-to-pour sequence.
Placard visibility from both sides does not change bowl removal, swapping, clearance, or cleaning access.
